prompt:
Cinematic architectural twilight photograph, 16:9 widescreen.
Composition: atmospheric diagonal framing shot looking through the warm glass lobby of a contemporary Seoul apartment residence out toward a quiet evening tree-lined neighborhood walkway. Warm golden interior wall lights contrast richly with deep midnight-blue twilight outside; soft reflections shimmer on sleek dark stone lobby tiles and glass doors. Distant blurred silhouettes of evening walkers, no one posing at camera.
Mood & lighting: calm intimate twilight atmosphere, deep clean dark shadows across center-left for text legibility, 35mm f/1.8 cinema lens, subtle film grain.
No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no sparkle icons anywhere. Ultra-clean edges.
